rubric.definition: The hobby narrative that a player has a credible path to enduring superstar or face-of-franchise demand.
rubric.scoreInterpretation: A directional editorial synthesis of consensus/pedigree, loud tools, narrative heat, hobby confirmation, and marketability. It is not a probability, player projection, card-price forecast, or recommendation.
rubric.confidenceInterpretation: Confidence measures the evidence behind the IT classification, not the chance that the player reaches the ceiling embedded in the story.
